color-no-hex.message: Use a semantic token (var(--color-*)) instead of a raw hex colour. Raw hex does not respond to the theme and is the cause of the dark-mode bugs this ratchet exists to prevent.

function-disallowed-list.message: Use a semantic token (var(--shadow-color-*), var(--color-scrim*), var(--color-surface-glass*), var(--color-border-glass*), etc.) instead of a raw rgb()/hsl() colour function. Only tokens/semantic.css and tokens/dark.css may alpha-blend colours directly.
